import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
from runtests4 import uniform_case
from validate import validate_request, Invalid
rng=random.Random(81)
for i in range(400):

        validate_request(json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':[case]}).encode())
    except Invalid as e:
        print(i,'invalid:',e); print(json.dumps(case)[:400]); break
